title: Hide a PCB layer in the board view
summary: Walks the board's V7 layer stack, finds a layer by name or TV6_Layer ID and hides or shows it in the view with IPCB_LayerObject_V7.IsDisplayed, plus a listing of every electrical layer's display state.
phrasings: turn off the top layer in the PCB view
show or hide a signal layer
check which board layers are visible

commands.name: HideLayer
commands.description: Hide (or show) a layer of the board view
commands.params: Layer=<layer name or TV6_Layer name> (optional, default the top layer)|Show=true (optional, show instead of hide)

commands.name: ListLayerDisplay
commands.description: List the layers of the stack and whether each is displayed
